skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding and applying general theoretical issues of international trade law
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand, analyze and apply general theoretical issues of international trade law such as subjects, sources of law, principles and institutions participating in international trade activities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and applying international trade law on goods
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand, analyze and apply legal regulations on international trade in goods.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and applying international trade law on services
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand, analyze and apply legal regulations on international trade in services.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and applying intellectual property law in international trade
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand, analyze and apply legal regulations on intellectual property in international trade.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and applying legal regulations on international trade contracts
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand, analyze and apply legal regulations on international trade contracts such as sales contracts, transportation contracts, marine insurance contracts, and international payment laws.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and applying dispute resolution mechanisms in international trade
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand, analyze and apply mechanisms for resolving disputes in international trade.
